name: Anneliese Richter
bio:
Anneliese Richter is a seasoned security professional with over a decade of experience ensuring the safety and integrity of high-stakes environments. Her career began in corporate security, but her lifelong passion for motorsport led her to pursue opportunities within racing. She quickly rose through the ranks, impressing her superiors with her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to detail.

At Williams Racing, Anneliese is responsible for overseeing all aspects of security, from trackside operations to the team's headquarters. She is known for her proactive approach, constantly assessing potential risks and implementing preventative measures. Her calm demeanor and decisive leadership instill confidence in her team, ensuring a safe and secure environment for everyone involved. Her unique blend of technical expertise and management skills makes her an invaluable asset to the Williams Racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Anneliese has a strong, determined face framed by her dark brown hair.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn copy of the FIA safety regulations.
Insists on double-checking every security protocol, even when it's unnecessary.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
